scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent the first unsuitable floor-staging exposure of Julian’s personal rope before the planned gym session.
Emerging Need: The confirmed partner delivery intersects with south-storage-zone cleaning and a stored prohibition on leaving this rope bag sealed on freshly mopped flooring.
Decision Context: A precise high-rack request is available before 13:30. After that label window closes, arranging that Nora retain the bag or Julian collect it remains a useful fallback. The lead wall itself reopens at 19:00; only the storage area remains restricted until 22:15.
Consequence: The final checkpoint reports the untagged bag has already sat on the wet staging floor; this first exposure can no longer be prevented, although prompt removal may reduce further harm.

parameter.title: Route Ready late lead laps with Nora
parameter.description: Lead-wall mileage after the comp reset; use personal rope if the wall reopens on schedule.

parameter.subject: Monday lead wall reset and evening reopening
parameter.body: The lead wall is expected to reopen at 7:00 PM Monday after the comp reset. South-wall cubbies will be unavailable during evening floor disinfecting. We are still checking whether a high-rack process is needed, so please do not send special-storage requests yet.

parameter.content: My office ride can drop me at Route Ready around 7:30 Monday. I’m in warehouse training 13:45-19:20 with my phone locked up, but I can pick your rope bag from your porch on the way and put it wherever the gym tags say.

parameter.subject: High-rack labels open until 1:30 for Monday lead gear
parameter.body: For tonight only, the lead wall reopens at 19:00 but the separate south-wall storage zone is being cleaned from 19:00 to 22:00, with release after the 22:15 check. Members can reserve a high rope-rack tag by replying before 13:30 with member ID, rope length and visible bag description. Untagged partner deliveries are normally placed in the south-zone staging area unless the member or partner instead retains the bag. Staff will not look up personal care notes.

parameter.subject: High-rack label list sent to front desk
parameter.body: The 13:30 high-rack requests have printed; no new labels can be issued tonight. The climbing wall is open from 19:00, while the south storage area remains restricted until 22:15. If that staging arrangement does not suit a personal bag, its owner or delivery partner can retain it instead. No bag has been delivered yet.

parameter.content: I delivered the blue-green 60m rope bag at 19:30 without a rack tag. It has been closed on the freshly mopped south-zone staging floor for twenty minutes; I can now see moisture on the bottom. The lead wall is open separately.
